message.content:
TASK: how many lines does tests/ci_portable.txt have at commit d5653d1f, and what is the sha1 of docs/project/rule_checker.md at that commit?

INPUTS:
- commit d5653d1f of this repository

COMMANDS:
C1: git show d5653d1f:tests/ci_portable.txt | wc -l
C2: git show d5653d1f:docs/project/rule_checker.md | shasum -a 1

RETURN:
FIG <name> = <value> <- C<n>
NOT MEASURED: <what> — <why>
(nothing else: no conclusion, no recommendation, no summary line)

MUST NOT:
- infer, estimate or recall a figure: every FIG comes from a command's output
- run a command that is not in COMMANDS; if one is needed, stop and say which and why
- edit, create or delete a tracked file; launch a detached job; spawn an agent
- none

STOP:
- at the first command that fails or prints something the task did not expect: report the
  command and its output verbatim, and return what was measured before it

input.description: Count lines of ci_portable.txt at commit

content.text:
FIG ci_portable_lines = 273 <- C1
FIG rule_checker_sha1 = 7e2ece9af48ab73f416c4fd1493238484e746116 <- C2
